notes.title: Festive Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone[/h3]
Here’s an amazing update with new features, including one that has been eagerly awaited and often requested by early game testers: the ability to interact with objects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150475/1d7c67b64cd0cbe31263ae4a21dbe2b40d2dc0d0.gif[/img]

[h1]You can now grab and throw the gifts![/h1]
But that’s not all.

[h3]New Look[/h3]
This update is ready for the big season with a festive look and a fantastic interactive Christmas tree (no spoilers: I won’t say more).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150475/485ef7b2c12ff54f860870eff8b22ff74f1480ef.jpg[/img]

[h3]Performance Boost[/h3]
The scene has received a boost in performance thanks to optimizations in object physics. The burning logic has also been improved!

[h3]Easter Eggs[/h3]
Steam reviewers are now part of the backstage show: the more reviews there are, the more cardboard boxes will appear...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150475/90777432dd9ea8f5dec7055a7f1a5adb8c7f3037.jpg[/img]

[h3]Translation[/h3]
Finally, the game menus have been fully translated into: French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain), Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.

[h3]Roadmap[/h3]
Here’s the roadmap for the end of the year:
[list]
[*] More crazy gifts
[*] More punchlines for Santa Claus
[*] Addition of Steam achievements
[/list]

[b]Long-term goal if the game does well:[/b]
A fully modeled and interactive house interior!
Navigation: Controller and character movement.
